details:
The Steadycam is a great way to show a steady POV of yourself. However, right now I have the following issues with it:

* You cannot tweak any basic camera variables like smoothness of the steadycam anywhere.

* You can only tweak the steadycam FOV outside of VRChat (in the VRChat json config).

I feel like adding a smoothness slider could help tremendously with having an even more "steadier" POV

And allowing the change of the FOV in game could make the feature not only more accessible to people but also easier to change and test around.

Im aware you folks say on: https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/configuration-file

> These systems aren't customized with settings you can set in the application, as the default settings are sufficient for the vast majority of VRChat players.

I still believe, that a lot of people, esp. those who want to record or stream their POV could benefit from more steadycam ingame settings like this.

TL:DR 

expose FOV settings for steadycam in vrchat's client and add more settings related to the steadycam (like smoothness or the recently added exposure as an example)

cheers
title: Add additional ingame settings for the steadycam
